user.title: Pair Toque Companion
user.description: On the robot, open Settings › Phone › Pair a phone (Toque 0.10.0+). Enter either the robot's local IP address + 6-digit code, or paste the QR pairing text (`toque://pair?...`).

data_description.host: Local IPv4 address of the robot (not a DNS hostname).
data_description.pairing_code: Temporary 6-digit code shown on the robot (valid for 2 minutes).
data_description.qr_text: Alternative to IP + code: full toque://pair?... string from the robot QR code.
data_description.sensor_only: Sensor only: won't expose or allow active commands like Pause, Stop, or Tare. Can be changed later via Reconfigure.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Toque robot discovered
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found "{name}" at {host}:{port}. On the robot, open Settings › Phone › Pair a phone and enter the 6-digit pairing code.

data_description.pairing_code: Temporary 6-digit code shown on the robot (valid for 2 minutes).
data_description.sensor_only: Sensor only: won't expose or allow active commands like Pause, Stop, or Tare. Can be changed later via Reconfigure.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair Toque Companion
reauth_confirm.description: The robot ({host}) rejected the stored pairing token. Open Settings › Phone › Pair a phone on the robot and enter a new 6-digit code or QR text.

data_description.sensor_only: Sensor only: won't expose or allow active commands like Pause, Stop, or Tare. Can be changed later via Reconfigure.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Toque Companion
reconfigure.description: Update the robot's local IP address or port (verified via cryptographic proof before sending the token), and choose whether to run in sensor-only mode.

data_description.sensor_only: Sensor only: won't expose or allow active commands like Pause, Stop, or Tare.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the robot. Check the IP address, port, and that the pairing screen is open (or another client is already paired).
error.code_dead: Too many wrong attempts: request a new pairing code on the robot.
error.code_expired: Pairing code expired: request a new code on the robot.
error.code_or_qr_required: Enter either a 6-digit pairing code OR a QR pairing text (not both).
error.different_robot: The paired robot does not match the existing device ID.
error.invalid_code_format: Pairing code must be exactly 6 digits.
error.invalid_host: Host must be a valid IP address (or localhost). DNS hostnames are rejected by Toque.
error.invalid_qr: Invalid Toque QR pairing string (expected toque://pair?... ).
error.pairing_closed: Pairing is not open on the robot. Open Settings › Phone › Pair a phone first.
error.proof_failed: Robot identity proof failed. The bearer token was not sent. Check the IP address or re-pair if this client was removed on the robot.
error.too_many_phones: Maximum paired clients (8) reached on the robot. Remove an old client on the robot first.
error.unsupported_protocol: This endpoint is not a supported Toque Companion v1 server.

abort.already_configured: This Toque robot is already configured.
abort.unsupported_protocol: This discovered device is not a supported Toque Companion v1 server.
